description:
This black-and-white photograph depicts a cow standing in a field, facing the viewer. The cow's distinctive markings include black ears, a black muzzle, and a white patch on its forehead, as well as large patches of black on its sides and hindquarters, broken up by smaller patches of white. The cow's lower legs and belly are predominantly white.

In the background, a blurry, wooden fence is visible, with trees and a small white building further away, suggesting a rural or farm setting.
